## Sources & Methodology

**Network.** XNET offload and device APIs provide telemetry and device counts. GB in network telemetry and billed GB in the revenue sheet are separate measurements. Device productivity uses the monthly average of operational devices. A deployed device may be awaiting carrier approval before it starts offloading. The current calendar month contains partial data.

**Revenue.** The [XNET revenue sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NebqJ876SNlO4xPihfJWzsH-V0xzgeA-Qw8i5VcHDU4/edit) provides projected WiFi revenue, payments, transfers and scheduled emissions. Service-month revenue and dated cash receipts are separate. Projected revenue, payments received and transfers can cover different periods. This is a community analytics mirror, so historical changes made in the team's published sheet are intentionally pulled forward on each rebuild instead of freezing superseded snapshots. The Annualized Earnings section uses trailing 30-day daily accrual × 365/30 and is a run-rate view, not guidance or a forecast. P/S continues to divide market capitalization by the latest-service annualized revenue run rate.

**Market.** DexScreener supplies pool prices, liquidity and rolling 24-hour volume. Price comes from the highest-liquidity XNET-base pool. Market capitalization = price × circulating supply; FDV = price × maximum supply. 

**Buy & Burn.** Burn charts cover the primary BBB wallet [5Qsy…URzfd](https://solscan.io/account/5QsyByFVJcg7oN76Ma26KEDFQdHt1tsiVExK94zURzfd). The historical unemitted-supply burn is excluded. Latest-burn amount sums burn events in that transaction. **Observed BBB Avg Daily Spend** is actual USD-equivalent BBB XNET-buy spend averaged across the latest 7 fully covered, completed UTC days; a covered day with no buys counts as $0. **Observed BBB Avg Buy Price** is the volume-weighted USD/XNET execution price across those same buys and same full-day window. Both are observed market execution, not rates inferred from the revenue-allocation policy. Cumulative burn percentage uses the published maximum supply of 1,307,098,713 XNET; the circulating-supply percentage uses the latest circulating supply.

**Emissions.** The XIP-11 schedule allocates 2.5 million XNET per 14-day epoch. Calendar-month totals prorate that rate by the number of days; schedule totals differ from the dates on which tokens are distributed.

**Emissions per GB.** Scheduled monthly XNET emissions ÷ network offload GB, for completed months. The USD series multiplies this ratio by the latest XNET price. It represents emission intensity at today’s price, rather than historical USD payouts or individual deployer earnings.

**Supply & ownership.** Month-end circulation is reconstructed from the September 24, 2026 supply checkpoint and the 61-wallet exclusion list gotten from the older XNET DUNE analytics page which accounts for Investor, Foundation and Operator emissions/unlocks and also includes transfers and circulating-token burns. Holders are positive-balance owners. Circulating-supply growth is the percentage change from the previous month-end observation; the current month uses its latest available observation.

**Coverage & source status.** Source dates in the freshness table indicate the age of each dataset. BBB USDC history starts on December 30, 2025. Daily closing balances are carried forward on days without balance changes, followed by current Solana RPC observations. Circulating-supply history starts on September 30, 2024.

[Source catalog](https://github.com/xnet-community-data/xnet-data-integration) · [XNET documentation](https://docs.xnetmobile.com/) · [XNET on DefiLlama](https://defillama.com/protocol/xnet)

**Live fee estimates.** To make XNET's 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day fee activity comparable with other networks, rolling fee estimates use XNET's daily offload-shaped accrual series. Closed unsettled months use the official monthly WiFi revenue projection. Current days use daily offload multiplied by a conservative effective API-GB revenue rate calibrated from the latest complete month. These figures are explicitly provisional and are rescaled when official monthly projections and carrier settlements arrive. During a short offload-API outage, only a bounded trailing fallback is used and flagged upstream.

**Carrier payment history.** April-June 2026 projected service revenue exceeded the historical $15,000 carrier payment cap. The dashboard preserves both the original service projections and the actual final $15,000 settlements, so users can distinguish projected network economics from the cash ultimately settled. The historical cap was subsequently removed; July 2026 settled at the full $33,688.91 service amount. August and September service-period amounts remain provisional until their carrier settlements are recorded in the source sheet.

### Revenue Settlement · Standard Route + Fiat Exception

**XIP-12 standard:** 60% Buy & Burn · 20% protocol-owned liquidity · 20% OpCo. **XIP-13.1 fiat exception:** eligible operators can choose fiat; their service allocation is 75% operator payout · 5% facilitation/BBB · 20% operations, with the corresponding assigned XNET emissions sent to burn. XIP-13.1 is **Passed** and uses the existing NET60+ settlement cycle. Fiat payouts inherit the service month from the carrier settlement that funds the payout, and are shaped across that reconciled service period.

# XNET

### 📡 Turning WiFi into carrier capacity

Mobile connectivity needs more than cell towers. **XNET is a carrier-grade, neutral-host wireless network that turns enterprise WiFi into capacity for mobile operators.** Its Passpoint infrastructure lets compatible phones connect automatically and securely, without captive portals or app downloads.

XNET brings together carriers, venues and infrastructure operators to expand coverage where people use mobile data. Operators earn rewards for carrying that traffic, linking wireless infrastructure to the XNET token on Solana.

Explore the network’s usage, revenue, token supply and Buy & Burn activity below.

**Fiat Operator Payout** is cash paid to operators choosing XIP-13.1 fiat for the service month shown. **Fiat-Routed Share** is the full fiat allocation as a share of that service month's WiFi revenue, before the 75% operator / 5% BBB / 20% operations split.

## Annualized Earnings Run Rate

Trailing 30-day daily accrual × 365/30. **Run-rate indicators only, not forecasts or guidance.** The values automatically reflect later carrier-settlement reconciliation and any historical restatements published in the XNET revenue sheet.
